results.snippet: Comex gold prices are trading lower in subdued U.S. trading Monday. Some profit taking and chart consolidation are featured to start the trading week, as the key “outside markets” are bearishly postured for the precious metals markets. The U.S. dollar index is higher and crude oil prices are lower. It’s a bit of a “risk-off” trading day in the market place Monday, as European and U.S. stock indexes are weaker, while the U.S. dollar index and U.S. Treasury prices are higher. The U.S. dollar index is trading higher Monday morning, on short covering in a bear market. The U.S. dollar bears still have the overall near-term technical advantage.
